summary: The subset is largely consistent and fail-closed, with strong scanner scoping, artifact validation, credential minimization, and V1–V6 verification contracts. Two bounded guidance conflicts could lead users toward unsafe retries or a locator pattern otherwise forbidden by the same contract.

findings.title: Retry guidance omits idempotence boundary
findings.evidence: The table recommends retrying an action-and-assert block with expect.toPass and gives a click as its example without restricting this to proven-idempotent actions, conflicting with the generator and debugger contracts that prohibit replaying non-idempotent writes without system-boundary proof.
findings.recommendation: Add the idempotence restriction directly to this table row and direct non-idempotent actions to a readiness gate instead.

findings.title: Forbidden count replacement suggests unqualified first()
findings.evidence: The replacement for a direct count read includes `.first() + toBeVisible()`, while the same file declares `.first()` forbidden unless immediately justified. Following the table literally can therefore generate code rejected by its own rules.
findings.recommendation: Remove `.first()` from the generic replacement or show it with the required concrete JUSTIFIED comment and single-result evidence.

limitations: This was a packet-only static review with no tool use, execution, syntax checking, or runtime observation.
The packet omits benchmark results, labeled holdouts, prior reviews, repository history, and some referenced supporting files and test implementations; no success is inferred for them.
This subset review is not full product coverage, skill-accuracy measurement, human or sealed review, independent ground truth, or remote model attestation.
